flash_errors.invalid_body: The request was malformed. This is a bug — please report it.
flash_errors.job_already_running: Another flash job is already running. Wait for it to finish or cancel it before starting a new one.
flash_errors.job_already_running_with_id: Flash job {jobId} is already running. Wait for it to finish or cancel it before starting a new one.
flash_errors.no_controllers: No controllers were selected. Pick at least one before flashing.
flash_errors.controllers_unknown: Some selected controllers haven't reported their firmware variant yet — wait a poll cycle and try again.
flash_errors.invalid_firmware: The selected file isn't a valid AstrOs firmware binary. Check the project name and version match an AstrOs build.
flash_errors.upload_io_failed: Couldn't stage the uploaded firmware on the server. Try again or check the server's disk space.
flash_errors.upload_persist_failed: The server couldn't save the uploaded firmware. Check the server logs and try again.
flash_errors.payload_too_large: The selected firmware file is larger than the server's 50 MB limit. Pick a smaller binary — check it isn't a combined app+partitions+spiffs image.
flash_errors.variant_mismatch: The selected release doesn't include a firmware variant for one or more of the selected controllers.
flash_errors.variant_unknown: One of the selected controllers reports a variant the server doesn't recognize.
flash_errors.release_not_found: The selected release could not be found on GitHub. Try refreshing the release list.
flash_errors.asset_not_found: The selected release exists but is missing a firmware asset for the selected controllers.
flash_errors.no_upload: Upload mode is selected but no firmware file has been uploaded yet.
flash_errors.release_lookup_failed: Couldn't reach GitHub to fetch the release. Check the server's internet connection and try again.
flash_errors.source_resolution_failed: Couldn't fetch the firmware binary from its source. Try again or pick a different release.
flash_errors.controllers_lookup_failed: The server couldn't look up the selected controllers. Try again.
flash_errors.subscriber_attach_failed: The server couldn't subscribe to deploy events. Try again or restart the server.
flash_errors.protocol_violation: Unexpected message format from the server. Try again or restart the master controller.
flash_errors.streamer_unknown_error: The firmware streamer failed with an unknown error. Try again.
flash_errors.source_read_failed: The server couldn't read the staged firmware file from disk. Re-upload or re-fetch the binary and try again.
flash_errors.source_size_mismatch: The firmware file's actual size doesn't match its declared size. Re-upload or re-fetch the binary and try again.
flash_errors.source_sha_mismatch: The firmware file's bytes don't match its cached hash — the cache is stale. Re-fetch (GitHub releases) or re-upload (local upload) the binary and try again; retrying without re-caching won't help.
flash_errors.begin_timeout: The master controller didn't acknowledge the transfer start. Check that the master is powered on and connected, then try again.
flash_errors.begin_rejected: The master controller rejected the firmware transfer. Check that the master has free SD card space, then try again.
flash_errors.chunk_retry_exhausted: Lost contact with the master controller during transfer (too many failed retries). Check the USB cable and the master's power, then try again.
flash_errors.flash_full: The master controller's SD card is full. Free space (delete older scripts or run FORMAT SD), then try again.
flash_errors.transfer_timeout: The firmware transfer didn't complete in time. Power-cycle the master controller, then try again.
flash_errors.end_timeout: The master controller didn't acknowledge transfer completion. Check the master, then try again.
flash_errors.hash_mismatch: The firmware that arrived at the master doesn't match the source binary (corrupted in transit). Try the flash again — if it persists, re-upload the binary.
flash_errors.master_io_error: Serial I/O error talking to the master controller. Check the USB cable and the master's power, then try again.
flash_errors.bus_send_failed: The server couldn't send to the master over the serial bus. Restart the server, then try again.
flash_errors.aborted: Flash cancelled. The controllers were not updated.
flash_errors.internal_server_error: The server hit an unexpected error. Check the server logs and try again.
flash_errors.network_error: Couldn't reach the server. Check your network connection and try again.
flash_errors.post_reboot_timeout: Master controller did not report a matching firmware version within 90 seconds. The flash may have failed; verify the controller and retry.
flash_errors.deploy_timeout: The master controller stopped responding during the update (no deploy progress for an extended period). The flash was aborted; check the master's power and USB connection, then try again.

playlist_editor_view.title: Playlist Editor
playlist_editor_view.cycle_error: Cannot save: track "{trackName}" at position {position} creates an infinite loop. Remove or replace this track and try again.
playlist_editor_view.help_body: Here's a breakdown of the different playlist types you can choose from:
playlist_editor_view.help_sequential: Plays tracks in the order they were added. Once the end of the playlist is reached, it stops. If another playlist or a script is sent to the server while a sequential playlist is playing, it will wait until the current playlist finishes before starting.
playlist_editor_view.help_sequentialinterruptible: Similar to Sequential. If a new playlist or script is sent to the server, it will interrupt the current playlist and start the new script or playlist as soon as the current track finishes.
playlist_editor_view.help_sequentialrepeatable: Plays tracks in the order they were added. Once the end of the playlist is reached, it starts over from the beginning. This type is always interruptible.
playlist_editor_view.help_shuffle: Plays tracks in a random order. Each track is played once until all tracks have been played, then it stops. This type is always interruptible.
playlist_editor_view.help_shufflewithrepeat: Similar to Shuffle, but once all tracks have been played, it reshuffles and starts again. This type is always interruptible.
playlist_editor_view.help_shufflewithdelay: Similar to Shuffle, but after each track is played, it waits for a specified delay before playing the next track. This type is always interruptible.
playlist_editor_view.help_shufflewithdelayandrepeat: Similar to Shuffle With Delay, but once all tracks have been played, it reshuffles and starts again. This type is always interruptible.
playlist_editor_view.sequential_nested_warning: Sequential playlists cannot contain nested playlists. {count} track will be removed. | Sequential playlists cannot contain nested playlists. {count} tracks will be removed.

reasonCode.STARTUP_OPEN_FAILED: The database could not be opened at startup. The server is running on a temporary in-memory database with no data.
reasonCode.BACKUP_FAILED: A pre-migration backup could not be written. The schema upgrade was skipped.
reasonCode.MIGRATION_FAILED_NO_BACKUP: A schema migration failed and there was no prior backup to restore from. The database may be in a partially-migrated state.
reasonCode.MIGRATION_FAILED_RESTORED: A schema migration failed but the database was successfully rolled back to the previous version. Investigate the failed migration before redeploying.
reasonCode.MIGRATION_FAILED_RESTORE_FAILED: A schema migration failed and the automatic restore also failed. Manual recovery is required.
reasonCode.UNKNOWN: The database is currently unavailable for writes.
